ambient_events: Grit ticks against the roof sheets in a long gust and then stops.
Somebody walks the length of the shed, unhurried, and does not come back.
The water butt by the racking gets a dipper run through it and put back on its hook.
A new rate goes up on the board in the same careful hand as the rest of them.
Out on the redrock, a truck starts, idles for a while, and shuts down again.
description: The shed floor, high enough to stand a trailer in and long enough to stand two. Diesel, hot iron, and the red grit that gets into everything out here. Trucks nose-in along one wall under a strip light; along the other, racking, a water butt, and a board with the day's rates chalked on it in a careful, patient hand. The door stands open on the redrock south.
name: The Deadleg — the shed
